title: [master]Subscription Billing: O(N²) contract-renewal detection in Sales-Post subscribers slows posting (~28% of batch CPU)
summary: Subscription contract renewal detection was optimized to eliminate O(N²) algorithmic complexity that consumed approximately 28 percent of batch posting CPU time.
key_points: Removed inefficient algorithm causing quadratic time complexity during contract renewal detection
Improves performance of sales posting operations in Subscription Billing module
Reduces CPU consumption during batch posting by approximately 28 percent
